verdict.rationale: LocalAI's docs mention a /models/apply API endpoint and installing models from the built-in gallery, which implies models can be added to a running server. Nothing explicitly documents switching between multiple loaded models per request, or confirms that no restart is needed. Missing for 10: explicit docs on multi-model concurrent loading and per-request switching, confirmation that no restart is required, model unload/memory management details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and switch between multiple models without restarting the server

citations.quote: PRELOAD_MODELS (or --preload-models) takes a list in JSON with the same parameter of the API calls of the /models/apply endpoint.
Install models from the built-in gallery (Discover page)
